I let my own priorities blind me to the immediate danger to him. It was... it was a failure to truly put myself in his shoes, to empathize with his experience in that moment.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: And after the boy fell, what did you do? Did you complete the mission? Did you speak to the sister?

I... I don't know if that was... the right thing to do... or if I was just... trying to atone... by... focusing on... the... mission. It... it was... a... failure of... leadership... and... humanity.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I see. And what have you done since then to ensure such a failure does not repeat itself? Have you changed your approach to missions involving civilians?

I... am... sworn... to... protect.
